description: ECHO: Retrieve a full compliance profile for a single EPA-regulated facility by EPA Registry ID or EPA program ID. Returns facility metadata, the NAICS industry codes its programs record, ECHO's facility-level compliance status, a per-statute (CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, and others ECHO tracks) compliance summary, inspections and other compliance monitoring records from the last five years (newest first, paged), five years of formal enforcement actions with penalties, five years of drinking-water violations with contaminant, measure, MCL, status, and enforcement actions (paged), the latest TRI release total, and the facility's TRI facility IDs for epa_tri_get_facility_releases. Use epa_echo_search_facilities to discover Registry IDs; pass a public water system's PWSID from epa_water_search_systems to get its drinking-water violations. For area-level enforcement discovery use epa_echo_search_violations instead.

drinking_water_violations_limit.description: Maximum number of drinking-water violations to return in one call (1–200, default 50). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 200 with a notice. Page past it with drinking_water_violations_offset and drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset.

drinking_water_violations_offset.description: Number of drinking-water violations to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

inspections_limit.description: Maximum number of inspections to return in one call (1–100, default 100). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 100 with a notice. Page past it with inspections_offset and inspectionsNextOffset.

inspections_offset.description: Number of inspections to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's inspectionsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

registry_id.description: EPA FRS Registry ID for the facility (from epa_echo_search_facilities), or an EPA program ID ECHO resolves to one: a public water system PWSID (from epa_water_search_systems, e.g. WA5300484), a TRI facility ID, an NPDES permit, or a RCRA handler ID. The profile carries the resolved registryId.

name: epa_echo_get_facility

airCompliance.description: Clean Air Act status. Present only when programs.air is true and ECHO reports a CAA status.

programId.description: ICIS-Air ID when the facility has exactly one; absent when it has several

status.description: Current Clean Air Act compliance status

statusDate.description: End of the latest quarter the status covers (MM/DD/YYYY)

compliance.description: Facility-level noncompliance count from ECHO's facility search record. Absent when ECHO reports none or the facility search request fails.

quartersInViolation.description: Quarters (of the last 12) in which any program found the facility in noncompliance

complianceStatus.description: ECHO's facility-level compliance status, the same value epa_echo_search_facilities returns (e.g. "Significant Violation"). Absent when ECHO assigns none, as for TRI-only facilities, or when ECHO's facility search request fails (the notice field then says so).

drinkingWaterViolations.description: Drinking-water (SDWIS) violations in ECHO's 5-year report for a public water system, newest compliance period first: one page of drinking_water_violations_limit entries from drinking_water_violations_offset. Empty for a facility with no SDWIS record.

items.description: Single drinking-water violation; fields ECHO leaves empty are absent, never defaulted

compliancePeriodEndDate.description: End of the compliance period (MM/DD/YYYY); absent when ECHO records none, as for an open period

contaminantName.description: Contaminant or rule group, e.g. "TTHM", "Arsenic", "Lead and Copper Rule"

enforcementActions.description: Enforcement actions ECHO links to the violation; absent when it lists none

items.description: Enforcement action ECHO links to the violation

agency.description: Agency that took it, e.g. State, EPA

description.description: Action, e.g. "State Administrative/Compliance Order without penalty issued"

federalMcl.description: Federal maximum contaminant level as ECHO writes it, units included (e.g. "0.080 mg/L")

federalRule.description: Federal rule violated, e.g. "Lead and Copper Rule", "Stage 2 Disinfectants and Disinfection Byproducts Rule"

resolvedDate.description: Date ECHO records the violation as resolved (MM/DD/YYYY)

sourceId.description: Public water system ID (PWSID) the violation is recorded against

stateMcl.description: State maximum contaminant level as ECHO writes it, units included

status.description: ECHO's violation status: Resolved, Archived (no longer counts toward the system's current compliance status; an Archived entry can still carry a resolvedDate), Addressed (not resolved, with formal enforcement), or Unaddressed (not resolved, no formal enforcement)

violationCategory.description: Violation category, e.g. "Maximum Contaminant Level Violation"

violationCategoryCode.description: Violation category code, e.g. MCL (maximum contaminant level), MR (monitoring and reporting), MON (monitoring), TT (treatment technique)

violationMeasure.description: Measured level as ECHO writes it, units included (e.g. "148.37 UG/L"); absent when ECHO records none, as for monitoring violations

drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset.description: Offset of the next page of drinkingWaterViolations: present exactly when more follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as drinking_water_violations_offset.

drinkingWaterViolationsTotal.description: Drinking-water violations in ECHO's report for this facility, across every page; 0 when it has no SDWIS record

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `facility_not_found`: ECHO has no facility for the given Registry ID or program ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

formalActions.description: Formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window, newest first

actionType.description: Type of formal enforcement action, e.g. "Administrative Order"

caseId.description: Enforcement case identifier; pass it to epa_echo_get_case for the civil case report (facilities, defendants, conclusions). Absent when ECHO records the action without one, as for RCRA and SDWA actions

leadAgency.description: Lead agency: EPA, State, or Local

settlementDate.description: Settlement date of the enforcement case (MM/DD/YYYY)

inspections.description: Inspections, evaluations, investigations, and other compliance monitoring records over the 5-year window, newest first: one page of inspections_limit entries from inspections_offset.

items.description: Single inspection or other compliance monitoring record

activityType.description: Inspection or evaluation type, e.g. "FCE On-Site", "PCE Stack Test", "Compliance Evaluation Inspection"

category.description: Kind of record, e.g. "Inspection/Evaluation", "Compliance Investigation", "Information Request", "Offsite Record Review"; absent for RCRA and SDWA records

description.description: Finding ECHO records for the inspection, when it records one

leadAgency.description: Lead agency: EPA, State, or Local

sourceId.description: Program ID inspected, e.g. an ICIS-Air ID, NPDES permit, RCRA handler ID, or public water system ID

inspectionsNextOffset.description: Offset of the next page of inspections: present exactly when more follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as inspections_offset.

inspectionsTotal.description: Compliance monitoring records in ECHO's 5-year history for this facility, across every page

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

naics.description: NAICS industry codes the facility's program records carry, each code once, ascending by code. Programs can record different codes for one site. Empty when no program records one.

description.description: NAICS title as ECHO records it, e.g. "Iron and Steel Mills and Ferroalloy Manufacturing"

notice.description: Present when ECHO's facility search request failed, so complianceStatus and compliance are missing; every other field comes from the facility's detailed report.

programCompliance.description: ECHO's per-statute enforcement and compliance summary. Empty when the facility is in no compliance-tracked program, as for TRI-only facilities.

items.description: One statute's enforcement and compliance summary

currentStatus.description: Current compliance status under this statute, e.g. "No Violation Identified"

formalActions.description: Formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window

informalActions.description: Informal enforcement actions over the 5-year window

inspections.description: Inspections or full compliance evaluations over the 5-year window

quartersInNoncompliance.description: Quarters in noncompliance over the 3-year window (of 12)

quartersInSignificantNoncompliance.description: Quarters in significant noncompliance over the 3-year window (of 12)

statute.description: Statute ECHO summarizes, e.g. CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, TSCA, EPCRA

totalPenaltiesInDollars.description: Penalties from formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window, in dollars

programs.description: Program registration flags, from the ECHO systems in the facility's detailed report

air.description: Has an ICIS-Air record (Clean Air Act stationary-source compliance). Emissions-inventory, risk-management, and greenhouse-gas reporting entries alone do not count.

rcra.description: Has an RCRAInfo record (RCRA hazardous waste handler)

sdwa.description: Has an SDWIS record (Safe Drinking Water Act public water system)

tri.description: Has a Toxics Release Inventory record — true exactly when triFacilityIds is non-empty

water.description: Has an ICIS-NPDES record (Clean Water Act discharge permit)

triFacilityIds.description: 15-character TRI facility IDs recorded for this facility, most recently reported first — pass one as facility_id to epa_tri_get_facility_releases for per-chemical releases. A site can carry several from successive operators. Empty when the facility has no TRI record.

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: Total TRI on- and off-site releases and transfers in pounds for triReleasesTransfersYear, ECHO's latest TRI year for this facility. Absent when ECHO holds no TRI history for it.

truncated.description: True when a list was cut at its limit: more drinking-water violations or inspections follow this page, and drinkingWaterViolationsNextOffset or inspectionsNextOffset continues it. Absent when neither list has more.

waterCompliance.description: Clean Water Act status. Present only when programs.water is true and ECHO reports a CWA status.

permitId.description: NPDES permit ID when the facility has exactly one; absent when it has several

status.description: Current Clean Water Act compliance status

title: Get EPA Facility Compliance Profile
